_about: Hebrew glossary and style rules for the Spoken Hebrew quest pack. The Hebrew is only ever spoken (ElevenLabs reads it; players never see it), so spelling serves pronunciation: niqqud is added where a name or word would otherwise be misread.
rules: The player is always addressed in the masculine singular (אתה, לך, תביא, לך לשם). Every player hears this one version.

Match the speaker's own gender in the first person: speakerGender 'female' speaks as a woman (אני בטוחה, הייתי עסוקה, אני מודה לך), 'male' as a man. Narrator lines (voice narrator-male) are notes, posters and books read aloud: keep the writer's gender when the text makes it clear, else masculine.

'Adventurer' (Spoken's stand-in for the player's name) is הרפתקן; as a bare greeting at the start of a line it may be dropped when the sentence reads naturally without it. 'adventurer' (the player's class) is also הרפתקן, 'traveler' (the player's race) is נוסע.

Natural spoken Hebrew in a fantasy register: clear and slightly elevated, never biblical or archaic, never slang. Keep the speaker's character: gruff orcs, cheerful gnomes, solemn priests, sly goblins.
Keep the meaning and every instruction (what to kill, collect, where to go, whom to see). Do not add or drop information. Keep length close to the English.

Single-word fantasy names are transliterated (Stormwind סטורמווינד, Westfall וסטפול); names made of separate English words are translated (Thunder Bluff צוק הרעם, Razor Hill גבעת התער). Use the glossary spelling exactly, including niqqud and the geresh (').
A name not in the glossary: transliterate it as it sounds in English, add niqqud only where a Hebrew reader could misread it, and report it in the output's newNames.
Write numbers as Hebrew words in the right gender (שמונה זנבות, עשרה פרוות). Keep '...' where the English trails off; it gives the voice a pause.
No Latin letters in the Hebrew. No stage directions or brackets that would be read aloud.

terms.Horde: ההוֹרְד (always with this niqqud; without the article: הוֹרְד)
terms.Sentinel: זקיפה (night elf sentinels are women; pl. זקיפות)
terms.Dark Iron: הברזל האפל (Dark Iron dwarves: גמדי הברזל האפל)
